name: City pop major-nine keys
desc: Tokyo-highway electric piano in Db major: Dbmaj9-Bbm9-Gbmaj9-Ab13 changes comped in warm syncopation on a VCSL FM piano, IV-of-IV lifts every 8th cycle, sparkle push chords on top at peak. Tatsuro Yamashita after sunset.

code.full: note("<[db3,f3,ab3,c4,eb4] [bb2,db3,f3,ab3,c4] [gb2,bb2,db3,f3,ab3] [ab2,c3,gb3,bb3,eb4]>").add(note(${root})).struct("[x ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~] [~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~ x]").s("fmpiano").clip(1.1).shape(.28).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.65, ${gain}).fast(4)).room(.35).delay(${echo}).delaytime(.375).delayfeedback(.25).pan(cosine.range(.44,.56).slow(10)).every(8, x=>x.add(note("<0 5>"))).orbit(4).play()
code.peak: stack(note("<[db3,f3,ab3,c4,eb4] [bb2,db3,f3,ab3,c4] [gb2,bb2,db3,f3,ab3] [ab2,c3,gb3,bb3,eb4]>").struct("[x ~ x x ~ x x ~]").clip(.8).shape(.32).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.7, ${gain}).fast(4)), note("<[f4,ab4] [db4,f4] [db4,gb4] [eb4,gb4]>").struct("[~ x]*4").clip(.5).shape(.25).gain(${gain}*.55).pan(.62)).add(note(${root})).s("fmpiano").room(.3).delay(${echo}*1.3).delaytime(.25).delayfeedback(.3).orbit(4).play()
